definitions.short: Gemarjah , the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H1587. Gemaryah or Gemaryahu גְּמַרְיָה גְּמַרְיָ֫הוּ, proper name, masculine ( ׳י hath accomplished ) — 1 גמריהו son of Shaphan Jer 36:10-11 , 12 , 25 . 2 גמריה son of Hilkiah Jer 29:3 . גַּנָּה גַּן, see below גנן .
definitions.rootNote: or גְּמַרְיָהוּ ; from 1584 and 3050 ; Jah has perfected;
